reference_code_semantics.pooling: BOS token index0 for each utterance independently
reference_code_semantics.MELD_reference_cleaning: ASCII encode errors=ignore then decode utf8; cannot silently apply to actual XP04 text without source confirmation
reference_code_semantics.IEMOCAP_reference_cleaning: pass stored utterance strings directly to roberta.encode
reference_code_semantics.extraction_truncation: not explicit in reference extraction; must establish before extraction rather than invent
reference_code_semantics.output_normalization: none in COSMIC extraction script; original XP04 model norm is a separate downstream operation

metrics_definition.MAE: mean absolute elementwise difference per layer
metrics_definition.RMSE: sqrt(mean squared elementwise difference) per layer
metrics_definition.cosine: per utterance; zero-vector cases separately counted, never fill with1
metrics_definition.correlation: Pearson per coordinate over corresponding Validation utterances; constants/undefined counted separately
metrics_definition.distribution: per-coordinate mean/std difference and first Wasserstein distance; no Validation-derived transformation

validation_policy: One final locked extraction/evaluation only, no feedback into encoder/parameters/tokenization; if prerequisites missing, all numerical results null and no extraction
historical_exposure: Prior audits saw package structure and some summaries. Independent means no current Validation feedback selection, not never-seen data.
